ops.title: PR 699: clear rate attribution when the active deletion ends
ops.description: Owner: yasyf, PR #699 implementation lane. Evidence: daemon/engine.go:1022 publishes paceJob before :1026 and :1029 clear e.active. If another physical job remains, the work loop keeps the governor active and can wait for paceUntil without another publication (:739-760). Job-specific Status then applies the previous rate to the completed or blocked job via :920-921; queue status omits the rate on finished rows at :425. Next step: publish the changed active identity whenever a deletion finishes, fails, or is parked, including transitions before the next slice.

ops.text: Job-specific and queue status stop attributing a rate to a finished or blocked job immediately when its active deletion ends.
CI covers a completed job followed by a queued physical job while paceUntil remains in the future.
